( 6 ) If you used equation W-10B to § 98.233 to calculate annual volumetric total gas emissions, then you must report the information specified in paragraphs (g)(6)(i) through (iii) of this section. ( i ) Vented natural gas volume, in standard cubic feet (“FV s,p ” in equation W-10B to § 98.233 ). ( ii ) Flow rate at the beginning of the period of time when sufficient quantities of gas are present to enable separation, in standard cubic feet per hour (“FR p,i ” in equation W-10B to § 98.233 ). ( iii ) If a multiphase flowmeter was used to measure the flow rate during the initial flowback period, report the average flow rate measured by the multiphase flow meter from the initiation of flowback to the beginning of the period of time when sufficient quantities of gas present to enable separation in standard cubic feet per hour. ( 7 ) Annual gas emissions, in standard cubic feet (“E s,n ” in equation W-10A or W-10B to § 98.233 ). ( 8 ) Annual CO 2 emissions, in metric tons CO 2 .
